ns2:section.sectionText: This section meets with the NRES Online M.S. program. Students will need a working external microphone/speakers or headset with microphone and high speed internet. Wireless internet is not recommended. Enrollment in this section requires Departmental Approval. E-mail nres-ssc@illinois.edu with your UIN, major, and year to request the override.
